study: Buy the clean breakout on the book: when a name on the desk's book clears a resistance order block (0.10-0.30% above the top of a sell zone broken in the last 15 minutes, by the desk's own live reading), does buying it beat (a) a different book name at the same minute and (b) the same name later in the day, after the full spread?
registered_at: 2026-10-08 ~04:30 ET, before any session from 2026-10-08 on is scored and before the scoring tool exists
origin: Operator 10/5-10/7: 'break out from resistance is a profit run ... never buy going into resistance'; WMT 10/7 (brk +0.11%) prompted 'hopefully we are logging the SR to see how we can take advantage'. The desk logs ob_* on every book check since 10/6-10/7 (ai_reports/shadow.jsonl, ~97% coverage on 10/7), so breakouts the desk did NOT trade are now observable. Distinct from sr_breakout_forward_prereg.json (H1-H3: the desk's own FILLS only, which this does not replace).
prior: LOW. sr_breakout_history_prereg.json FAILED (6 weeks of minute data); SR levels 10/2: breaking resistance was the WORST of 7 S/R states; the 0.10-0.30% 'clean' band was the one better band in the 10/5 in-sample cells (not significant). 10/7 day review (information, seen before registration, excluded here): 3 clean events, -6.3 bp gross 15m.

data.signal: ai_reports/shadow.jsonl on the mini: every book check row (ts, symbol, source, price, ob_brk_dist_pct, ob_resist_0.3, ob_room_pct, ob_bars, spread_r). The breakout reading is the LIVE IEX one the desk sees (ob_observe.breakout_dist on the desk's 1-min IEX bars, blocks known by that minute). Rows without ob fields are counted and skipped, never imputed.
data.fills_and_outcomes: SIP trades and NBBO (Alpaca historical, after hours): never the shadow 'price' field (memory: shadow price inflates backtests).
data.sessions: every session from 2026-10-08 on (10/06-10/07 seen in development: excluded). Sessions with a desk restart between 09:45 and 15:30 are kept; book checks during a restart gap simply do not exist.

event.definition: a book check at time c, 09:45 <= c <= 15:30 ET, with 0.10 <= ob_brk_dist_pct < 0.30 (CLEAN), on a name whose immediately preceding check (same symbol, within 120 s before c) had ob_brk_dist_pct None or < 0.10 (a NEW clean reading, not a continuation). One event per symbol per 15 minutes (the first); one event per symbol per broken block is implied by the 15-min break window.
event.entry: first SIP regular trade at or after c + 2 s (desk latency); cost = full SIP NBBO spread at the entry trade's time (half in, half out) plus 1 cent round trip when price < $5; a missing quote within 300 s before entry drops the event (counted), never cost 0
event.exit: PRIMARY: last SIP regular trade at or before entry + 15 min (net15). If no trade in that minute, the last trade before it; if halted (no SIP 1-min bars for >= 5 minutes covering the exit), the first trade after resume (counted).
event.groups: by the event row's source: TIGHT (source 'tight') and MOVERS (every other desk source). Scored and decided separately; pooled is information only.

controls.CONTROL_A_primary: cross-name, same minute: a random (seed 59, per event '59|SYM|c') OTHER symbol checked on the book within +/-30 s of c, in the SAME group, whose own check at that time has ob_brk_dist_pct None and ob_resist_0.3 not True, and that is not itself an event within +/-15 min. Same entry (c + 2 s), exit, cost. No candidate -> pair dropped (counted). Chosen from information at c only.
controls.CONTROL_B_secondary: same name, later: a random (seed 59) book check of the SAME symbol starting after the event's exit (entry + 15 min) and by 15:30, with ob_brk_dist_pct None; same entry/exit/cost. Never drawn before or during the event trade (the 10/06 hindsight-control artifact). No candidate -> dropped (counted). Information only.

statistic: per group: mean net15 of events (bp) and the paired mean of EVENT minus CONTROL_A; SE clustered by session; halves = alternate sessions (A even index, B odd index in the sorted list of scored sessions)
power: before any mean, per group per half: n events, n pairs, SE and MDE = 2.84 x SE for the paired contrast. UNDERPOWERED if the paired-contrast MDE > 15 bp (TIGHT) or > 40 bp (MOVERS), or fewer than 60 pairs per half.
pass: per group (Bonferroni 2: |t| bar 2.24): EVENT minus CONTROL_A >= +5 bp with session-clustered t >= 2.24 pooled over both halves, positive in BOTH halves, AND EVENT net15 > 0 pooled (it must make money after the spread, not just lose less), AND >= 60 pairs per half. FAIL if the pooled paired t <= -2 (with or without power). Otherwise UNDERPOWERED: keep collecting. A PASS earns a pre-registered paper A/B of a breakout arm for that group (skeptic review first); it changes nothing live by itself.
decision_date: scored weekly from 2026-10-15 for power only (counts, SE, MDE; no means shown); the verdict is read once both halves of a group reach 60 pairs, or on 2026-12-15 (R1 review) with whatever power exists, whichever comes first
information_only: bands POKE (0 < brk < 0.10) and CHASE (brk >= 0.30), same rules, as separate cells
events split by ob_room_pct after the break (None = no resistance overhead vs > 0)
events split by %R state at c (fast %R rising over the prior 3 checks vs not), when the row carries pctr
events the desk actually bought within 5 min (and their realized round trips) vs not
session coverage: share of book checks carrying ob fields; events dropped by reason
tool: tools/studies/sr_breakout_book.py (to be written; skeptic code review before it scores any session). Read-only: shadow.jsonl + Alpaca historical SIP after 16:30 ET. Added to scripts/nightly.sh as count-only until 2026-10-15.
no_retuning: the 0.10-0.30% band, the 'new reading' rule, 2 s latency, 15-min hold, controls, seeds, groups and bars are fixed here; any change is a new pre-registration
caveats: the breakout reading uses the port's order blocks on the desk's IEX bars; the operator's TradingView zones can differ (10/7 chart check: matched on liquid names, mismatched on thin premarket names)
book checks are not uniform in time (names enter and leave the book; check cadence varies)
the book itself is selected (names up on the day); both controls are book names, so the contrast is within the book
tight names move little in 15 minutes: the MDE bar for TIGHT is tighter and may take weeks to reach
